z-m-22-08.title: Ezinombolweni ezintathu isamba sazo singu-6, isamba sezikwele zazo nasso simisiwe?
z-m-22-08.goal: Khombisa ngezibonelo eziphikisayo ukuthi isamba sezikwele asimisiwe uma kwaziwa kuphela isamba, bese usebenzisa izinkulumo ukuhlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwalumisa.
z-m-22-08.material: Ezinombolweni zangempela a, b, c, kwaziwa ukuthi a+b+c=6. Ake sibone ukuthi leli qiniso lisivumela ukwazi inani le-a²+b²+c², futhi uma kungenjalo, yini enye edingekayo. (a² ifundwa "a squared".)
z-m-22-08.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokubala inani lenkulumo ngokufaka izinombolo
z-m-22-08.s.s1.prompt: Ezinombolweni zangempela a, b, c, a+b+c=6 kuphela okwaziwayo. Linini inani le-a²+b²+c²?
z-m-22-08.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha noma yiziphi izinombolo ezintathu isamba sazo singu-6 bese ubala a²+b²+c².
z-m-22-08.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha enye isethi yezinombolo ezintathu bese uqhathanisa ukuthi kuphuma inani elifanayo yini.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.a: Limisiwe ku-36. Ungalithola ngokushesha ngokwenza isikwele sika-6
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi (a+b+c)² ifana no-a²+b²+c². Hlola ukuthi yimaphi amagama ayengeziwe avela uma unweba (a+b+c)².
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.b: Limisiwe ku-12. Izinga yinani elivela ekuhlukaniseni u-6 ube izingxenye ezintathu ezilinganayo
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.b: Ubheke icala a=b=c=2 kuphela. Hlola ukuthi amanye amacala anikeza inani elifanayo yini.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.c: Alimisiwe. Inani lincike ku-a, b, c
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi noma ngesamba esifanayo, isamba sezikwele singashintsha uma a, b, c ziyashintsha.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.d: Limisiwe, kodwa alikwazi ukubalwa ngolwazi olwaziwayo manje
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.d: Uma limisiwe, inani elifanayo kumele livele kunoma yisiphi isibonelo esinesamba 6. Lihlole ngezibonelo ezimbili.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.explain: Uma isibonelo esinesamba 6 singu-(2,2,2), ngakho a²+b²+c²=12, futhi uma singu-(6,0,0), singu-36, ngakho inani alimisiwe libe linye.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibonelo ezimbili zezinombolo ezintathu ezine-a+b+c=6 kodwa amanani ahlukile e-a²+b²+c², bese ukhombisa ukuthi inani alimisiwe.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza izinombolo ezintathu isamba sazo singu-6, bese ubala isamba sezikwele futhi uzibhale etafuleni.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha izibonelo ezimbili ezinezamba zezikwele ezihlukile.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, (2,2,2) inikeza u-12, (6,0,0) inikeza u-36, (1,2,3) inikeza u-14, futhi (4,1,1) inikeza u-18. Noma ngesamba esifanayo, izamba zezikwele zihlukile, ngakho a+b+c=6 kuphela akumisi. Izibonelo ezimbili ezinikeza inani elifanayo (isibonelo, (1,2,3) no-(3,2,1)) azibalwanga njengezibonelo ezihlukile.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.prompt: Ngaphezu kwa-a+b+c=6, yiliphi kuma-qiniso alandelayo, uma likwaziwa nalo, elingamisa inani le-a²+b²+c² libe linye? Khetha wonke.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqiniso ngalinye, funa izibonelo ezimbili ezine-a²+b²+c² ehlukile noma likwaziwa leli qiniso.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala phansi uhlobo olunwetshiwe lwe-(a+b+c)² bese uhlola ukuthi yiliphi iqiniso eligcwalisa isikhala kuleyo nkulumo.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.a: Funa isibonelo lapho abc ifana kodwa a²+b²+c² ihlukile. (Isibonelo, (6,0,0) no-(3,3,0) ngo-abc=0)
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.b: Ubone ukuthi ixhumana kanjani no-a²+b²+c² ohlotsheni olunwetshiwe lwe-(a+b+c)².
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.c: Hlola ukuthi, noma c imisiwe, a no-b zingaqhubeka nokushintsha ngenkathi zifeza a+b=6−c yini.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.d: Ubale ukuthi a²+b²+c² no-ab+bc+ca ziveza kanjani uma lena inkulumo inwetshwa.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.e: Cabanga ukuthi lolu lwazi olusha yini, njengoba selivele lisebenza kunoma yisiphi isibonelo esinesamba 6.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.explain: Njengoba (a+b+c)²=a²+b²+c²+2(ab+bc+ca), uma wazi ab+bc+ca, ngakho a²+b²+c²=36−2(ab+bc+ca) imisiwe. Njengoba (a−b)²+(b−c)²+(c−a)²=3(a²+b²+c²)−36, ukwazi leli nani nakho kuyamisa. Inani le-abc, inani lika-c, no-"okungenani 12" akumisi inani.

z-m-22-02.title: U-x⁴+4 akanazimpande ezingempela, kodwa ungabhalwa njengomkhiqizo?
z-m-22-02.topic: Ukwenza izici (ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nezici, ukuguqula ngokwengeza nokukhipha inkathi)
z-m-22-02.goal: Qinisekisa isihlanganiso esithi "uma kungekho zimpande, akunakwenziwa izici" ngesibonelo esiphikisayo nokuguqula okuthile, bese wenza wena izisho lapho indlela efanayo isebenza khona.
z-m-22-02.material: Sikhuluma ngaphakathi kwebanga lapho ama-coefficient e-polynomials eyizinombolo ezingempela. UJihu wathi, "Akukho u-x ongempela onelisa u-x⁴+4=0. Ngakho u-x⁴+4 akanakwenziwa izici." Ake sihlole ukuthi singasikholwa yini isitatimende sikaJihu njengoba sinjalo. ("x⁴" ifundwa "x to the fourth power".)
z-m-22-02.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokwenza izici zezisho ze-quadratic zefomu u-ax²+bx+c
z-m-22-02.s.s1.prompt: Ake sibheke ukuthi isahlulelo mayelana nesitatimende esithi "uma kungekho zimpande ezingempela, akunakubhalwa njengomkhiqizo" siguquka kanjani njengoba kuza ulwazi olusha.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ngokuhlukile ukuthi ucezu ngalunye lolwazi luthinta u-"isitatimende jikelele" noma lithinta u-"x⁴+4 uqobo".
z-m-22-02.s.s1.hint.1: Andisa isisho esinikeziwe wena bese uhlola ukuthi silingana nesisho sokuqala yini.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.info: U-x⁴ ungu-0 okungenani, ngakho u-x⁴+4 ungu-4 okungenani njalo. Okungukuthi, akukho u-x ongempela lapho u-x⁴+4=0. Uma i-linear expression u-x−k iyisici, inani lesisho kumele libe ngu-0 ku-x=k, ngakho akukho sici se-linear esinama-coefficient angempela.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngolwazi lwamanje kuphela, uhlulela kanjani ukuthi u-x⁴+4 ungabhalwa yini njengomkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezinama-coefficient angempela?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi akukho sici se-linear, kodwa ithuba lomkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic lisavuliwe. Okwamanje, kunengqondo ukugcina isahlulelo sakho noma ukushiya ithuba livulekile.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Akunakubhalwa. Akukho sici se-linear, ngakho akuhlukani nakuzisho ze-quadratic
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Weqe kusuka eqinisweni lokuthi akukho sici se-linear uye ku-"akukho mkhiqizo osebenzayo". Ucabangile ukuthi umkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic uyenzeka yini?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Akunakunqunywa okwamanje. Ithuba lomkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic lisasele
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uhlukanisa ukungabi nasici se-linear nokungahlukani kube ngumkhiqizo.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kungabhalwa. Uma u-4 wengezwa, njalo uyahlukana
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akuhlukani ngoba nje u-4 wengeziwe. Udinga iqiniso njengesisekelo.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kungabhalwa. Izisho ezinamandla alingana zonke ziyahlukana
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: U-x²+1 naye uyisisho esinamandla alingana, kodwa akahlukani abe izisho ze-linear ezinama-coefficient angempela. Cabanga ngesibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Isisho esifanayo u-x⁴+5x²+4 naso asinazimpande ezingempela ngoba u-x⁴+5x²+4≥4. Kodwa uma ubuka u-x² njengo-A, khona-ke u-A²+5A+4=(A+1)(A+4), ngakho u-x⁴+5x²+4 ungabhalwa njengo-(x²+1)(x²+4).
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uhlulela kanjani isitatimende sikaJihu jikelele, "uma kungekho zimpande ezingempela, akunakubhalwa njengomkhiqizo"?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.after: U-x⁴+5x²+4 akanazimpande ezingempela kodwa usahlukana abe ngu-(x²+1)(x²+4), ngakho isitatimende sikaJihu jikelele asisebenzi. Kodwa lokho akubonisi ukuthi u-x⁴+4 uyahlukana.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Isitatimende jikelele siphukile. Kodwa ukuthi u-x⁴+4 uyahlukana kumele kuhlolwe ngokuhlukile
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uhlukanisa ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo siphula isitatimende jikelele, nokuthi ukuthi isisho esithile siyahlukana kuyindaba ehlukile.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Manje u-x⁴+4 ngokuqinisekile angabhalwa njengomkhiqizo nawo
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Isibonelo esiphikisayo siphula isitatimende jikelele kuphela; asiqinisekisi ukuthi u-x⁴+4 uyahlukana.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isitatimende sikaJihu sisalungile. U-x⁴+5x²+4 uyisisho esihlukile
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: "Uma kungekho zimpande ezingempela, akuhlukani" isitatimende ngazo zonke izisho, ngakho esinye isisho esisodwa siyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: U-x⁴+5x²+4 wahlukaniswa ngokushintsha u-x² waba ngu-A, ngakho akakwazi ukusetshenziswa njengesibonelo esiphikisayo
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Andisa u-(x²+1)(x²+4) bese uhlola wena ukuthi ulingana nesisho sokuqala yini.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Uma wengeza futhi ukhipha u-4x² ku-x⁴+4, khona-ke u-x⁴+4=(x⁴+4x²+4)−4x²=(x²+2)²−(2x)².
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.after: U-(x²+2)²−(2x)²=(x²+2−2x)(x²+2+2x)=(x²−2x+2)(x²+2x+2). Hlola ukuthi ukwandisa kunika u-x⁴+4. Noma kungekho zimpande ezingempela, ungabhalwa njengomkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: U-(x²+2)²−(2x)² unenani elihlukile ku-x⁴+4, ngakho akunakusetshenziswa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Andisa u-(x²+2)² bese ukhipha u-4x², bese ubala ukuthi uthola u-x⁴+4 yini.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: U-(x²+2)²−(2x)²=(x²+2)−(2x), ngakho uba yisisho esisodwa se-quadratic
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Umehluko wezikwele u-(A−B)(A+B), futhi awuphenduki isisho esisodwa u-A−B.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Uba ngumkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic, u-(x²−2x+2)(x²+2x+2)
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ufunde indlela yokuguqula umehluko wezikwele ezimbili ube ngumkhiqizo.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ungumehluko wezikwele ezimbili, ngakho awuhlukani ngaphezulu ezinombolweni ezingempela
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: U-A²−B²=(A−B)(A+B) uyasebenza noma ngabe u-A no-B bayizisho zini.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, iqiniso lokuthi akukho sici se-linear lalingenele ukufinyelela esiphethweni. Njengoba isibonelo esiphikisayo nokuguqula okuthile kuvela, isahlulelo saba sinqunyiwe. Uma uqale waqagela "akuhlukani", sho ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oluguqule lowo mcabango.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.prompt: Ake senze izisho u-x⁴+c² lapho indlela efanayo no-x⁴+4 isebenza ngaphakathi kwama-coefficient aphelele. Uma uphinda ubhale u-x⁴+c² ngefomu u-(x²+c)²−(dx)², ubudlelwano obuthini u-c no-d okumele babe nabo? Thola amapheya amabili ahlukile lapho u-c no-d beyizinombolo zemvelo futhi u-c engu-3 okungenani.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.hint.0: Andisa u-(x²+c)² bese uqhathanisa ukuthi yiyiphi inkathi ehluke ku-x⁴+c².
z-m-22-02.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi inkathi esele kumele ibe yisikwele senombolo iphi, bese ngemuva kokukhetha u-d, bala u-c.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.ok.c1: U-c ungu-3 okungenani futhi u-d uyinombolo yemvelo.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c1: U-c kumele abe ngu-3 okungenani futhi u-d kumele abe ngu-1 okungenani.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c2: U-c no-d kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c3: U-(x²+c)²=x⁴+2cx²+c², ngakho u-(dx)² no-2cx² kumele balingane. Qhathanisa u-d² no-2c.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.explain: U-x⁴+c²=(x²+c)²−2cx², ngakho uma u-2c eyisikwele senombolo ephelele u-d², uhlukana abe ngu-(x²−dx+c)(x²+dx+c). U-(c, d)=(8, 4) unika u-x⁴+64=(x²−4x+8)(x²+4x+8), u-(18, 6) unika u-x⁴+324=(x²−6x+18)(x²+6x+18), futhi u-(32, 8) unika u-x⁴+1024=(x²−8x+32)(x²+8x+32). Uma ama-coefficient angempela evunyelwe, uhlukana kuwo wonke u-c oyiphozithivu ngo-d=√(2c), kodwa uma kunqunyelwe ezinombolweni eziphelele, kudingeka ubudlelwano obunjena.

z-m-22-03.title: Yini enye esingayifunda eqinisweni lokuthi izisele ziyafana?
z-m-22-03.topic: Usebenzisa i-remainder theorem (izisele ezivela ezibonakalweni ezimbalwa ze-linear)
z-m-22-03.goal: Sebenza ukuthi isahlulelo mayelana nesisele uma ukuhlukanisa ngesisho se-quadratic siguquka kanjani njengoba amaqiniso mayelana nezisele eyengezwa eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese wenza wena izisho eziningana ezanelisa izimo ezifanayo.
z-m-22-03.material: U-f(x) uyi-polynomial enama-coefficient angempela futhi idigri yayo ayaziwa. Ukuhlukanisa kwe-polynomial kubhalwa ngefomu u-f(x)=(isihlukanisi)·(ikhwosheni)+(isisele), futhi idigri yesisele ingaphansi kwedigri yesihlukanisi. Njengoba amaqiniso aziwa eyodwa ngesikhathi, ake sibheke ukuthi yini engashiwo ngesisele uma u-f(x) ehlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2).
z-m-22-03.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa uma ulwazi olusha luguqula isahlulelo nalapho lungaluguquli
z-m-22-03.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokubhala isisele se-polynomial ehlukaniswe nge-linear expression ngefomu u-f(x)=(isihlukanisi)(ikhwosheni)+isisele
z-m-22-03.s.s1.prompt: Ake sibheke ukuthi isinqumo sami mayelana nensalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) sishintsha kanjani njengoba amaqiniso mayelana nezinsalela engezwa eyodwa ngesikhathi. (Izinga lika-f(x) alaziwa.)
z-m-22-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kabusha iqiniso ngalinye njengesibalo ngenani, njengo-"f(1)=…".
z-m-22-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala insalela njengo-ax+b bese ubala izibalo eziveliswa yiqiniso ngalinye eyodwa ngesikhathi.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Iqiniso 1: Insalela uma f(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-x−1 ingu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ungasho ini manje mayelana nensalela uma f(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2)?
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Uma insalela ingu-ax+b, ngeqiniso 1 kuphuma isibalo esisodwa kuphela, a+b=4, ngakho a no-b azimisiwe.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Akukabi khona ulwazi ngo-x−2. Cabanga ukuthi f(2) kumele ibe ngu-4 nayo yini ukuze insalela ibe ngu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Isisho sezinga elingu-1 ngokuphezulu, futhi lolu lwazi lodwa alumisi
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ubheke kokubili isimo senzalela (izinga elingu-1 ngokuphezulu) nokushoda kolwazi.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Insalela ngu-4x. Ngoba inani lingu-4 ku-x=1
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kunezisho eziningi ngaphandle kuka-4x ezinenani elingu-4 ku-x=1.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Sekuvele kukhona umkhawulo wokuthi insalela ingu-4 ku-x=1. Awazi lutho.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Iqiniso 2: Insalela uma f(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-x−2 nayo ingu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje insalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) iyini?
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kusukela ku-a+b=4 no-2a+b=4, a=0 no-b=4, ngakho insalela ingukungaguquki 4. Lokhu kungoba uma f(1)=f(2)=4, f(x)−4 iyahlukaniswa kokubili ngo-x−1 no-x−2.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ayikamiswa. Kukhona isibalo esisodwa esengeziwe nje
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Manje kunezibalo ezimbili. Hlola ukuthi ungathola yini u-a no-b ezibalweni ezimbili.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wahlulele usebenzisa izibalo ezimbili a+b=4 no-2a+b=4 ndawonye.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Iqiniso 3: Insalela uma f(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-x−3 ingu-5. (Isibonelo, f(x)=½x²−(3/2)x+5 yanelisa amaqiniso 1, 2, no-3.)
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uma leli qiniso lengezwa, insalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) izoshintsha?
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Esibonelweni f(x)=½x²−(3/2)x+5, f(x)−4=½(x−1)(x−2), ngakho insalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) ihlala ingu-4. Iqiniso 3 liwulwazi ngephoyinti elihlukile, f(3)=5.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ubone ukuthi amaqiniso 1 no-2 asemise kakade insalela futhi iqiniso 3 likhuluma ngephoyinti elihlukile.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kushintsha kube ngu-5. Iqiniso elifundwe ekugcineni lithatha indawo yeqiniso elifundwe ngaphambili
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubona ulwazi olusha njengolususa lolwangaphambilini. Cabanga ukuthi amaqiniso angaphambilini asaliyiqiniso yini.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kushintsha kube yinani eliphakathi kuka-4 no-5. Ngoba iqiniso elisha lixuba namaqiniso akhona
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hlola ngesisho esibonelweni ukuthi insalela ixutshwa njengesilinganiso samanani athile yini.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Amaqiniso 1 kuya ku-3 aphikisana, ngakho akukho f(x) eyanelisa lezi zimo
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Faka u-1, 2, 3 ku-f(x) enikeziwe njengesibonelo bese uhlola ukuthi onke amaqiniso amathathu ayiqiniso yini.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.reflect: Ngeqiniso 1 ubungakwazi ukumisa, uma kwengezwa iqiniso 2 kwamiswa, futhi iqiniso 3 lalingakwazi ukushintsha lokho okwase kumisiwe. Zama ukuhlukanisa amacala lapho ulwazi olusha lushintsha isinqumo nalawo lapho lungashintshi.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izisho ezintathu ezihlukene f(x)=ax²+bx+c ezanelisa f(1)=4 no-f(2)=4. (a=0 kuvunyelwe.)
z-m-22-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala f(1) no-f(2) ngo-a, b, c ukwenza izibalo ezimbili.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha inani lohlamvu olulodwa (isibonelo, a) bese uhlola ukuthi ezinye izinhlamvu ezimbili ziyalandela.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Inani a+b+c elivela ekufakeni u-x=1 alingu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.explain: Kuzimo ezimbili, b=−3a no-c=4+2a, ngakho ukukhetha ngakunye ka-a kwenza elilodwa. Isibonelo, (1, −3, 6) ngu-x²−3x+6, (2, −6, 8) ngu-2x²−6x+8, (−1, 3, 2) ngu-−x²+3x+2, no-(0, 0, 4) ungukungaguquki 4. Zonke zine-f(x)−4=a(x−1)(x−2), ngakho insalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) ingu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Uma f(1)=f(2)=4, chaza ukuthi kungani insalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) ingu-4 kuzo zonke izibonelo ezintathu.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala ubale futhi ubhale ukuthi f(1) no-f(2) ziyini kusisho ngasinye sezintathu.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ungakhipha inombolo muphi ku-f(x) ukuze ibe ngu-0 kokubili ku-x=1 nasku-x=2.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi f(x)−4 iba ngu-0 ku-x=1 nasku-x=2?
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhubekele esiphethweni sokuthi insalela ingukungaguquki 4?
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Njengoba f(1)=f(2)=4, f(x)−4 ingu-0 kokubili uma x=1 nalapho x=2. Ngakho iyahlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2), futhi f(x)=(x−1)(x−2)·i-quotient+4, ngakho insalela ingu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Ezisho zonke ezintathu f(1)=f(2)=4, ngakho uma sikhipha u-4, u-1 no-2 baba yizimpande futhi (x−1)(x−2) iyisici sika-f(x)−4. Ngakho insalela ingu-4.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Uma ngibhala insalela njengo-px+q, khona p+q=4 no-2p+q=4, ngakho p=0 no-q=4. Ngakho insalela ingukungaguquki 4.

z-m-22-05.title: Uma kwaziwa kuphela amazinga, amazinga ama-polynomial amabili amisiwe?
z-m-22-05.goal: Ukusebenzisa izimo ezimbili ngamazinga omphumela nesamba ukuthola amazinga ama-polynomial amabili, bese uqinisekisa ngezibonelo ukuthi i-coefficient yethemu eliphezulu idlala iliphi iqhaza uma isimo sishintsha.
z-m-22-05.material: f(x) no-g(x) ayi-polynomial ezingeyona u-0 ezinama-coefficient angempela. Amaqiniso amabili angezansi ayaziwa. (1) Izinga lika-f(x)g(x) lingu-6. (2) Izinga lika-f(x)+g(x) lingu-3. Izinga liyi-exponent yamandla aphezulu phakathi kwamathemu angeyona u-0. Ukungaguquki (inombolo engeyona u-0) kunezinga elingu-0. Ake sibheke ukuthi amaqiniso aziwayo asivumela yini ukumisa amazinga ka-f no-g, nokuthi kwenzekani uma ulwazi lushintsha.
z-m-22-05.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokuthi ithemu eliphezulu linqunywa kanjani esambeni nasemiphumeleni ye-polynomial ezimbili
z-m-22-05.s.s1.prompt: f(x) no-g(x) ayi-polynomial ezingeyona u-0 ezinama-coefficient angempela. Amazinga ama-polynomial amabili angamiswa kusukela emaqinisweni kuphela okuthi izinga lomphumela f(x)g(x) lingu-6 nezinga lesamba f(x)+g(x) lingu-3?
z-m-22-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala wonke amapheya lapho amazinga amabili ahlangana abe ngu-6, njengo-(6,0), (5,1), (4,2), (3,3).
z-m-22-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kupheya ngalinye, hlola eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuthi izinga lika-f(x)+g(x) lizoba yini.
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.a: Elilodwa linezinga elingu-6 futhi elinye lungukungaguquki kwezinga elingu-0. Ngoba umphumela unezinga elingu-6
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise kuphela izinga elingu-6 lomphumela futhi awusebenzisanga izinga elingu-3 lesamba. Hlola ukuthi izinga lesamba liyini ku-(izinga 6, izinga 0).
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.b: Akunakumiswa. Kunamapheya amaningana anezinga lomphumela elingu-6, njenge-(4, 2) noma (5, 1)
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.b: Kunamapheya amaningana anezinga lomphumela elingu-6, kodwa ingabe uhlungile abakhethiwe ngesimo sokuthi isamba sinezinga elingu-3?
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.c: Elilodwa kuphela linezinga elingu-3 futhi elinye linezinga eliphansi kuno-3. Ngoba isamba sinezinga elingu-3
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.c: Usebenzise kuphela izinga elingu-3 lesamba futhi awusebenzisanga izinga elingu-6 lomphumela. Hlola ukuthi umphumela wesisho sezinga elingu-3 nesisho sezinga eliphansi unezinga elingakanani.
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.d: Bobabili banezinga elingu-3. Amanye amapheya ngeke abe nesamba sezinga elingu-3
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.d: Uhlungile abakhethiwe usebenzisa zombili izimo, izinga lomphumela nezinga lesamba.
z-m-22-05.s.s1.explain: Umphumela unezinga elingu-6, ngakho (isamba samazinga)=6. Uma amazinga amabili ehluka, izinga lesamba liyizinga elikhulu (4 noma ngaphezulu) futhi alikwazi ukuba ngu-3, ngakho amazinga amabili kumele afane, futhi bobabili banezinga elingu-3.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.prompt: Ake senze u-f(x) no-g(x) abanezinga lomphumela elingu-6 nezinga lesamba elingu-3 ngokubhala amathemu aphezulu kuphela. Vumela izinga lika-f libe ngu-m ne-coefficient yethemu eliphezulu p, nezinga lika-g libe ngu-n ne-coefficient yethemu eliphezulu q. Thola izibonelo ezimbili ezihlukene. (Ukushintshanisa u-f no-g kunikeza isibonelo esifanayo.)
z-m-22-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe ipheya elinamazinga amabili ahlangana abe ngu-6 bese usebenza izinga lesamba.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma amazinga elingana futhi wengeza ama-coefficient amathemu aphezulu.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Amazinga kumele abe yizinombolo eziphelele ezingu-0 okungenani.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ama-coefficient amathemu aphezulu akumele abe ngu-0.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Izinga lomphumela yisamba samazinga amabili. m+n akungu-6.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Izinga lesamba alingu-3. Bheka ukuthi ithemu eliphezulu alinyamali yini uma amazinga elingana, nokuthi izinga elikhulu liyini uma amazinga ehluka.
z-m-22-05.s.s2.explain: Amazinga ombili kumele abe ngu-3, futhi ama-coefficient p no-q amathemu aphezulu kumele angabi u-0 ngo-p+q≠0 ukuze isamba sigcine izinga elingu-3. Isibonelo: uma p=q=1, khona f=x³+…, g=x³+…, futhi isamba singu-2x³+…. Uma p=1, q=−1, ithemu eliphezulu liyanyamalala futhi isamba sinezinga eliphansi kuno-3.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.prompt: Isimo sishintshile. Izinga lomphumela lisengu-6, futhi izinga lesamba f(x)+g(x) kuthiwa lingu-2. Amazinga ama-polynomial amabili azoba yini?
z-m-22-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi ithemu elinezinga eliphezulu lisala kanjani esambeni se-polynomial ezimbili ezinamazinga ahlukile.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza isibonelo esisodwa bese uhlola wena amazinga omphumela nesamba.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.a: (4, 2) noma (2, 4). Isamba sinedigri 2, ngakho eyephansi inedigri 2
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.a: Uma amadigri ehlukile, idigri lesamba liba idigri eliphezulu (4). Isamba asikwazi ukuba nedigri 2.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.b: Zombili zinedigri 3, futhi isamba se-coefficient singu-0 ukuze amagama amabili anedigri eliphezulu anyamalale
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.b: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi igama elinedigri eliphezulu lingaphela kuphela uma amadigri elingana.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.c: Zombili zinedigri 3, futhi isamba se-coefficient zamagama anedigri eliphezulu asiyona 0
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.c: Uma igama elinedigri eliphezulu lisala, isamba sinedigri 3. Cabanga ukuthi yini okumele yenzeke ukuze isamba sibe nedigri 2.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.d: Akukho f(x) no-g(x) abafeza le mibandela
z-m-22-05.s.s3.explain: Uma amadigri ehlukile, idigri lesamba liba elikhulu (4 noma ngaphezulu) futhi alikwazi ukuba ngu-2. Ngakho zombili kumele zibe nedigri 3 futhi amagama anedigri eliphezulu kumele anyamalale. Isibonelo: uma f=x³+x², g=−x³+x, umkhiqizo unedigri 6 futhi isamba singu-x²+x, esinedigri 2.

z-m-22-06.title: Uma kunemibandela emibili kodwa a no-b kusengamiswanga
z-m-22-06.goal: Hlulela ukuthi okungaziwa kumisiwe hhayi ngenani lemibandela kodwa ngenani lezingcezu zolwazi ezizimele, bese ukhetha imibandela eyisitatimende esifanayo esibhalwe ngokuhlukile noma imibandela ehlala iyiqiniso.
z-m-22-06.material: f(x)=x³+ax²+bx−6, lapho a no-b ziyizinto ezihlala zingashintshi zangempela. Isitatimende esithi "isisele uma kuhlukaniswa ngenkulumo eqondile singu-0" nesitatimende esithi "leyo nkulumo eqondile iyisici se-f(x)" kusho into efanayo. Ake sibheke ukuthi amaqiniso aziwayo nge-f(x) amisa yini amanani a-a no-b njengebhangqa.
z-m-22-06.prereq.1: Yazi ukuthi uma isisele se-polynomial ehlukaniswe ngenkulumo eqondile singu-0, ngakho leyo nkulumo eqondile iyisici (ihlukanisa ngokulinganayo)
z-m-22-06.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni nemibandela lapho isixazululo sezibalo ezihlanganyelwe simiswa sibe sinye
z-m-22-06.s.s1.prompt: Ku-f(x)=x³+ax²+bx−6 (a no-b ziyizinombolo zangempela), thola amabhangqa amathathu ahlukile (a, b) enza u-x−1 abe yisici se-f(x).
z-m-22-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi yiliphi inani le-x elenza u-x−1 alingane no-0, bese ubhala ukuthi f kumele ibe yini kuleli nani.

z-m-22-06.s.s1.explain: Uma u-x−1 eyisici, ngakho f(1)=1+a+b−6=0, ngakho a+b=5. Kunamabhangqa amaningi njengoba ufuna anesamba 5, njengo-(0, 5), (1, 4), (−1, 6), (2, 3). Umbandela owodwa awumisi a no-b libe ibhangqa elilodwa.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.prompt: f(x)=x³+ax²+bx−6. Khetha onke amasethi alandelayo lapho lawo maqiniso kuphela amisa (a, b) libe ibhangqa elilodwa.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kusethi ngayinye, bhala kabusha amaqiniso amabili njengezibalo ezimumo "f(inombolo ethile)=inani".
z-m-22-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi izibalo ezimbili ziyizingcezu zolwazi ezihlukile noma enye ivela ngqo kwenye.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.o.a: U-x−1 uyisici se-f(x). x=1 isixazululo sesibalo f(x)=0.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.a: Ingabe uqhathanise ukuthi imisho emibili iliqiniso elifanayo yini. Uma isho into efanayo, kuvela isibalo esisodwa kuphela.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.b: Lawa angamanani ezindaweni ezimbili ezihlukile, ngakho kuvela izibalo ezimbili ezizimele ku-a no-b.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.c: Bhala ngqo ukuthi f(0) inikeza sibalo siphi ku-a no-b.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.d: Ubone ukuthi uthola izibalo ezimbili ezisho ukuthi amanani ku-x=1 no-x=−1 womabili angu-0.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.o.e: U-x−1 uyisici se-f(x). Isisele uma f(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-x+2 singu-−6.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.e: Isisele uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-x+2 singu-f(−2). Ulwazi oluvela endaweni ehlukile ku-x=1, okungu-x=−2, ngakho kuvela izibalo ezimbili ezizimele, a+b=5 no-2a−b=4.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.explain: a: yomibili imisho isho f(1)=0, ngakho kunesibalo esisodwa kuphela. c: f(0)=−6 ligama elihlala njalo −6 lenkulumo, ngakho lihlala liyiqiniso noma ngabe a no-b ziyini, okusho ukuthi alinikezi ulwazi olusha futhi f(1)=0 kuphela esala. b: a+b=5, 2a+b=−1 → (a, b)=(−6, 11). d: a+b=5, a−b=7 → (6, −1). e: kusuka ku-f(1)=0, f(−2)=−6, a+b=5, 2a−b=4 → (3, 2).
z-m-22-06.s.s3.prompt: Umngane uthi, "Kunomkhawulo wokuthi u-x−1 uyisici, futhi kunomkhawulo wokuthi i-coefficient ehamba phambili yomphumela wokuhlukanisa lapho f(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-x−1 ingu-1, ngakho kunemibandela emibili futhi a, b ziyanqunywa." Bhala ocabanga ngalesi sitatimende, ngezizathu.
z-m-22-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala f(x)=(x−1)(umphumela wokuhlukanisa), qhathanisa amagama e-x³ ezinhlangothini zombili, bese ubhala ukuthi igama eliyinhloko lomphumela wokuhlukanisa liyini.
z-m-22-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi lowo mphumela ucishe amanani a-a no-b yini, bese uxhuma emphumeleni we-s1 ukuthi bangaki amabhangqa (a, b) asalayo uma kunikezwe kuphela umbandela wokuthi u-x−1 uyisici.

z-m-22-13.title: Singakwazi ini ngama-coefficient ngaphandle kokuwanwebisa?
z-m-22-13.prereq.0: U-H3 kulo msebenzi uyizinga lobunzima le-batch yokukhiqiza kuphela futhi akulona ibanga elisetshwe uhlelo lwezifundo. Cabanga ukuthi usuvele wafunda iyunithi ye-polynomial ye-High School Common Math (imisebenzi emine ye-polynomials, ukuhlukanisa okufanayo, nokwenza izici).
z-m-22-13.prereq.1: Ukuthola inani lenkulumo ngokufaka inombolo ku-polynomial
z-m-22-13.topic: Ama-coefficient e-polynomial namanani uma kufakwa izinombolo
z-m-22-13.goal: Hlela ukuthi yimaphi ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-coefficient ongawazi nokuthi yimaphi ongawazi kumanani atholwa ngokufaka izinombolo, yenza izisho zakho ezanelisa ubudlelwano, futhi uchaze isizathu ngamagama alula.
z-m-22-13.material: Uma unwebisa u-f(x)=(2x−1)⁵, kuvela amagama kusukela ku-x⁵ kuya egameni eliqhubekayo. Qamba i-coefficient yegama ngalinye c5, c4, c3, c2, c1, c0 (c5 yi-coefficient ka-x⁵ futhi c0 yigama eliqhubekayo). Kulo msebenzi, ngaphandle kokunwebisa, sicabanga ukuthi singakwazi ini nokuthi singakwazi ini kumanani atholwa ngokufaka kuphela u-0, 1, −1 ku-x. (2x−1)⁵ ifundwa ngokuthi "2x ukukhipha u-1, kukhuphukele kuka-5".
z-m-22-13.s.s1.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi unwebise u-f(x)=(2x−1)⁵ futhi wabhala u-f(x)=c5x⁵+c4x⁴+c3x³+c2x²+c1x+c0. Khetha konke ongakuthola usebenzisa amanani atholwa ngokufaka u-0, 1, −1 ku-x ngaphandle kokunwebisa.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi isimo esinwebisiwe sika-f(x) siba lula kanjani uma ufaka u-x=0, 1, −1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi yimaphi amagama anyamalala uma wengeza noma ukhipha imiphumela ka-x=1 no-x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.a: Ubone ukuthi uma ufaka u-x=1, wonke amandla ka-x kuyo yonke igama aba ngu-1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.b: Ngamanani amathathu 0, 1, −1, awukwazi ukwehlukanisa eyodwa kwama-coefficient ayisithupha. Bala ukuthi ungathola ama-equation amangaki.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.o.c: Isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd c5+c3+c1
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi uma ukhipha amanani ku-x=1 no-x=−1, amagama ezinga le-even ayanyamalala.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.d: Uxhumanise iqiniso lokuthi uphawu lwama-coefficient luka-(2x−1)⁵ lushintshana nenani ku-x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.e: Awukwazi ukuthola u-c4 ngokuhlukile emanani ambalwa afakwe ku-x. Qhathanisa inani lama-equation owathola nenani lezimiso ezingaziwa.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.explain: Ku-x=1, f(1)=c5+…+c0=(2−1)⁵=1, futhi ku-x=−1, f(−1)=−c5+c4−c3+c2−c1+c0=(−3)⁵=−243. Isamba sama-coefficient edigri engalingani singu-(f(1)−f(−1))/2=122. Ama-coefficient ashintshana ngophawu (32, −80, 80, −40, 10, −1), ngakho isamba samanani aphelele singu-|f(−1)|=243. U-c3 noma u-c4 akakwazi ukutholwa ngamunye.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.acc.0: U-a no-c bakhethwe kahle. U-d udinga ukwazi nokuthi uphawu lwama-coefficient lushintshana, ngakho udinga umcabango owodwa owengeziwe.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.prompt: Ku-cubic expression u-f(x)=x³+ax²+bx+c, yenza izisho ezintathu ezihlukile lapho isamba sonke sama-coefficient singu-0 futhi isamba sama-coefficient ezinkathini zedigri engalingani (x³, x) nasso singu-0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isamba sonke sama-coefficient nesamba sama-coefficient ezinkathini zedigri engalingani ngasinye njenge-equation ku-a, b, c.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha uhlamvu olulodwa kuqala bese uthola ezinye.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Isamba sama-coefficient ezinkathini zedigri engalingani singu-0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.fail.c2: Isamba 1+b sama-coefficient ezinkathini zedigri engalingani (x³, x) asisiyo u-0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.explain: U-b=−1 no-c=−a. Izibonelo: uma u-a=0, x³−x; uma u-a=1, x³+x²−x−1; uma u-a=2, x³+2x²−x−2. Lezi zisho zinu-f(1)=0 no-f(−1)=0, ngakho zonke zinu-(x−1)(x+1) njengesici, futhi u-x³+ax²−x−a=(x−1)(x+1)(x+a).
z-m-22-13.s.s3.prompt: Umfowenu omncane weBanga 3 lesikole esiphakathi ubuza, "Awuzange ngisho wandise u-(2x−1)⁵, ngakho wazi kanjani isamba sama-coefficient?" Chaza ukuze umfowenu aqonde.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi u-x⁵, x⁴, ..., x ngamunye uba yini uma ufaka u-1 esikhundleni luka-x.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ngamazwi omfowenu ukuthi isisho esandisiwe no-(2x−1)⁵ kuyisisho esifanayo.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma ufaka u-1 esikhundleni luka-x, ...
z-m-22-13.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubhale ukuthi uma ufaka u-1 esikhundleni luka-x, wonke amandla aba ngu-1 futhi kusala ama-coefficient kuphela?
z-m-22-13.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ubhale ukuthi isisho esandisiwe nesisho esingandisiwe kuyisisho esifanayo, ngakho ukufaka kokubili kunika inani elifanayo?
z-m-22-13.s.s3.model.0: Efomini elandisiwe luka-(2x−1)⁵, uma ufaka u-1 esikhundleni luka-x, u-x unyamalala futhi kusala kuphela isamba sama-coefficient. Ngakho isamba sama-coefficient singu-(2×1−1)⁵=1.
z-m-22-13.s.s3.model.1: Uma ufaka u-x=1, wonke amandla ka-1 angu-1, ngakho ikhefu ngalinye lisala nje i-coefficient. Isisho esandisiwe nesisho esingandisiwe kuyisisho esifanayo, ngakho ngifaka ku-(2x−1)⁵ olulula, bese ngithola u-1.

z-m-22-01.title: Kusalani uma u-x ku-2026th power ehlukaniswa ngo-x²−1?
z-m-22-01.goal: Usebenzisa amanani enza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0, qinisekisa ukuthi kungani umthetho wezisele oqagelwe ezibonelweni ezimbalwa usebenza nasemandleni amakhulu, bese uwusebenzisa uma uhlukanisa ngenye i-quadratic expression.
z-m-22-01.material: Uma u-x^n (isisho esinokuphindaphinda u-x izikhathi ezingu-n, u-n inombolo yemvelo) ehlukaniswa nge-quadratic expression u-x²−1, ungabhalwa njengo-x^n=(x²−1)Q(x)+R(x), futhi isisele u-R(x) siyisisho sedigri engu-1 ubuningi (kuhlanganise okungaguquki). Ngokubheka imiphumela ye-n = 1, 2, 3, ... eyodwa ngesikhathi, ake sicabange ngesisele uma u-n=2026. "x to the 2026th power" isisho esinokuphindaphinda u-x izikhathi ezingu-2026.
z-m-22-01.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ukuthi uqiniseka kangakanani esahlulelweni sakho njengoba ulwazi lukhula
z-m-22-01.prereq.0: U-H3 kulo msebenzi uyizinga lobunzima le-batch yokukhiqiza kuphela futhi akulona ibanga elisetshwe uhlelo lwezifundo. Cabanga ukuthi usuvele wafunda iyunithi ye-polynomial ye-High School Common Math (imisebenzi emine ye-polynomials, ukuhlukanisa okufanayo, nokwenza izici).
z-m-22-01.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokubhala ukuhlukanisa kwe-polynomial ngefomu u-A=BQ+R (idigri luka-R lingaphansi kwedigri luka-B)
z-m-22-01.prereq.2: Uphawu lwamandla luka-(−1) (u-1 uma kuphindaphindwe inani elilinganayo lezikhathi, u-−1 uma kuphindaphindwe inani elingalingani lezikhathi)
z-m-22-01.s.s1.prompt: Ake sibheke ukuthi isahlulelo mayelana nesisele luka-x^n ohlukaniswe ngo-x²−1 siguquka kanjani njengoba ulwazi lukhula.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izisele ethebuleni eceleni komunye kanye nokuthi u-n ungalingani noma ulingana.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, bhala ngegama elilodwa ukuthi isahlulelo sakho "siqinile, siguqukile, noma sihlale sinjalo."
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.info:
Umphumela wokuhlukanisa ngqo (isisele kuphela esibhaliwe)
n=1: x¹ = (x²−1)·0 + x → isisele x
n=2: x² = (x²−1)·1 + 1 → isisele 1
n=3: x³ = (x²−1)·x + x → isisele x
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngolwazi olunalo manje kuphela, ucabanga ukuthi isisele siyini uma u-n=2026?
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kokubili isiqagelo esithi "u-1 uma ulingana, u-x uma ungalingani" nesahlulelo sokuthi ufuna ukubona izibonelo eziningi kunengqondo okwamanje. Kodwa izibonelo ezintathu zisisekelo sesiqagelo kuphela, hhayi ubufakazi.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqagela umthetho wokuthi u-x no-1 bayashintshana, u-x uma ungalingani, u-1 uma ulingana.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awuzange ufake umphumela osuka ku-n=2 emthethweni.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kusenesikhathi sokunquma. Ngifuna ukubona izibonelo eziningi njengo-n=4, 5
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uyazi ukuthi kunezibonelo ezintathu kuphela futhi ulibazisa isahlulelo.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ezisele zemigqa emithathu, awuboni i-coefficient ikhula. Wenze umthetho ohlukile kulokho okubonwe.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.info:
Imiphumela yokuhlukanisa okwengeziwe
n=4: x⁴ = (x²−1)(x²+1) + 1 → isisele 1
n=5: x⁵ = (x²−1)(x³+x) + x → isisele x
Zonke izibonelo ezinhlanu zihambisana no-"x uma ungalingani, 1 uma ulingana".
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ungasethemba kangakanani isiqagelo esithi "uma u-n=2026, isisele ngu-1" manje?
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Njengoba izibonelo ziyanda, isiqagelo siqina, kodwa ukuthi sisebenza yini kuwo wonke u-n kumele kuqinisekiswe ngesizathu.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Manje seliqinisekisiwe. Belilungile izikhathi ezinhlanu zonke, ngakho kumele lisebenze
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Noma ngezibonelo eziningi, "wonke u-n" akuqinisekisiwe. Udinga ukwazi ukuthi kungani kusebenza nakwa-n amakhulu.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inkolelo yami ikhulile, kodwa angazi ukuthi kungani, ngakho ayinqunyiwe
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: U-n=2026 mkhulu kakhulu, ngakho ukubikezela akunamsebenzi
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uma udela ukubikezela ngoba u-n mkhulu, awukwazi ukusebenzisa umthetho. Qala ngokucabanga ukuthi ungathola yini isizathu.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ezinhlanu azanele, ngakho ngihlukanisa ngqo kuze kube ngu-n=2026 ukuhlola
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukuhlukanisa ngqo akulona iqiniso. Cabanga ukuthi kukhona yini indlela yokuthola isizathu.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ake sithole isizathu. Isisele sinedigri engu-1 ubuningi, ngakho singabhala u-R(x)=ax+b. Ku-x^n=(x²−1)Q(x)+ax+b, u-x²−1=(x−1)(x+1), ngakho u-(x²−1)Q(x) uba ngu-0 noma ufaka u-1 noma u-−1 ku-x. Bese u-1=a+b no-(−1)ⁿ=−a+b kuyasala.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Usebenzisa lolu lwazi, thola isisele uma u-n=2027.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma u-n=2027, khona-ke u-(−1)ⁿ=−1, ngakho u-a+b=1 no-−a+b=−1, kunika u-a=1, b=0, ngakho isisele ngu-x. Ngendlela efanayo, ku-n=2026, u-a=0 no-b=1, ngakho isisele ngu-1.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola ukuthi ubale u-(−1)ⁿ njengo-1 yini, njengakwa-n=2026.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Usebenzise ama-equation womabili ukuthola u-a no-b.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uma kungu-x+1, qhathanisa ukuthi u-a+b uyini no-1=a+b.
z-m-22-01.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni waqagela umthetho ngezibonelo ezintathu, futhi njengoba izibonelo ziyanda inkolelo yakho yakhula, kodwa ukuqiniseka kwakho kwavela esizathini sokuthi "isihlukanisi siba ngu-0 ku-x=1 no-x=−1". Ungagcina isiqagelo sakho sokuqala, kodwa bheka ukuthi isisekelo saso sishintshe kanjani kusuka ku-"inani lezibonelo" kuya ku-"isizathu".
z-m-22-01.s.s2.prompt: Ake sisebenzise indlela efanayo ecaleni lokuhlukanisa u-x ku-2026th power ngo-x²−4. (x²−4=(x−2)(x+2)) Isisele siyini?
z-m-22-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ngokulandelana okufanayo njengo-x²−1, bhala amanani ku-2 nasku-−2.
z-m-22-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngokunquma ukuthi u-(−2) ku-2026th power uyiphozithivu noma uyinegethivu.

z-m-22-12.title: U-x⁴−4 kufanele uhlukaniswe kude kangakanani ngaphambi kokuthi kuqediwe?
z-m-22-12.topic: Ukuhlukanisa ngezici (ukuhlukanisa okuphelele ngokuya ngebanga lama-coefficient)
z-m-22-12.goal: Qonda ukuthi isahlulelo sokuthi ukuhlukanisa ngezici "kuqediwe" sincike ebangeni lama-coefficient, futhi unqume ukuthi ubhala kanjani impendulo uma kungekho banga elinikeziwe.
z-m-22-12.material: Kunezixazululo ezintathu zika-x⁴−4. Isixazululo ①: (x²−2)(x²+2), Isixazululo ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), Isixazululo ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Zonke izixazululo ezintathu zinika u-x⁴−4 uma zinwebisiwe. Ekuhlukaniseni ngezici, igama elithi "akuhlukaniseki kakhulu" lincike ekutheni yiziphi izinombolo ezivunyelwe njengama-coefficient.
z-m-22-12.prereq.2: Incazelo eyisisekelo yezinombolo ezinzima (iyunithi engokomcabango i, i²=−1)
z-m-22-12.s.s1.prompt: Kunezixazululo ezintathu ezihlukanisa u-x⁴−4 ngezici. Isixazululo ①: (x²−2)(x²+2). Isixazululo ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2). Isixazululo ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Khetha zonke izitatimende ezilungile ezingezansi. (i iyiyunithi engokomcabango futhi i²=−1.)
z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.0: Nwebisa izici zesixazululo ngasinye futhi uhlole ukuthi uthola u-x⁴−4.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga eyodwa ngeyodwa ukuthi isici ngasinye siyahlukaniseka futhi ngama-coefficient alelo banga.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.a: Uma ama-coefficient elinganiselwe ezinombolweni eziphelele, isixazululo ① asikwazi ukuhlukaniswa kakhulu
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.a: Uyazi ukuthi "ukuphela" kunqunywa ukuthi ubani ibanga lama-coefficient olisebenzisayo.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.b: Uma ama-coefficient evunyelwe kuze kufike ezinombolweni zangempela, isixazululo ① asikahlukaniswa ngokuphelele
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi ezinombolweni zangempela, u-x²−2 uhlukaniswa abe izisho ezimbili ze-linear.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.c: U-x²+2 uhlukaniswa abe ngu-(x−√2)(x+√2) ezinombolweni zangempela
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.c: Ukunwebisa u-(x−√2)(x+√2) kunika u-x²−2. Hlola ukuthi uyafana no-x²+2 yini.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.d: Noma ngabe ibanga lama-coefficient lingakanani, isixazululo ① siwukuhlukanisa kokugcina
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.d: Kukhona izisho ezingahlukaniswa kakhulu njengoba ibanga lama-coefficient liba banzi.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.e: Uma izinombolo ezinzima zivunyelwe, u-x²+2 naye uhlukaniswa abe ngumkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-linear
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.e: Ubone ukuthi izixazululo ze-x²+2=0 zingokomcabango, ngakho ezinombolweni ezinzima uhlukaniswa abe izisho ze-linear.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.explain: "Ukuphela" kokuhlukanisa ngezici kuncike ebangeni lama-coefficient. Ezinombolweni eziphelele kungu-(x²−2)(x²+2), ezinombolweni zangempela kungu-(x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), futhi ezinombolweni ezinzima kungumkhiqizo wezisho ezine ze-linear. U-x²+2 akahlukaniseki kakhulu ezinombolweni zangempela, futhi (x−√2)(x+√2)=x²−2.
